# Market import fixtures (SYNTHETIC)

| File | Designation | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `asking_prices_synthetic.json` | synthetic | `suv-deals market import` / `domain.market_import`: four invented MK asking prices for the synthetic "Example Trail" of the fixture dealer pages, on reserved `*.example` hosts. |

Every price, URL and vehicle here is invented for tests. They are not real MK observations and must
never be imported into a production workspace. No file contains seller contact data (the importer
refuses it).
